name: BC Snow Survey Administrative Basin Areas

metadata.source: BC Geographic Warehouse Snow Survey Administrative Basin Areas
metadata.purpose: Snow Survey Network station naming and snow-program reporting areas
metadata.lineageStatement: May 15, 2019 the linework for the boundaries was updated.
metadata.derivationAssessment: The official metadata does not identify an existing BC Data Mapper boundary family as a parent. Preserve this published program-specific partition rather than deriving it from FWA, drainage, health, or administrative boundaries.
metadata.hydrologicContext: Some basin edges closely follow hydrologic units, but the complete 23-basin partition is not equivalent to the existing FWA or BC Drainage families.
